PSX for the Analogue Pocket (openFPGA)

Shell skeleton: APF bridge, clocks, memory controllers and the data slots. The PlayStation core is a stub
until the core replaces it. Layout, slots and build: docs/pocket/POCKET_TOP.md in the PSX_MiSTer repository.

Copy this folder's Cores/, Platforms/ and Assets/ to the root of the Pocket SD card. Put the BIOS at
Assets/psx/defgenx.PSX/psxbios.bin.
